name: usblc6_dc_T25
spice:
* ST Table2 leakage VBR VF; 25 C run is outside published model validity
.OPTIONS TEMP=25 RELTOL=1u ABSTOL=1p VNTOL=1n
Vrail rail 0 5.25
Xbr brio 0 brp3 brp4 brv brp6 MY_LIB_USBLC6_2SC6_DS
Ibr 0 brv 1m
Xleak li 0 leakp3 leakp4 lv leakp6 MY_LIB_USBLC6_2SC6_DS
Vlv lv 0 5.25
Vli li 0 0
Eleak leakcur 0 VALUE={-I(Vlv)}
Xf1low f1lowv 0 f1lowp3 f1lowp4 0 f1lowp6 MY_LIB_USBLC6_2SC6_DS
If1low 0 f1lowv -0.01
Ef1low f1lowabs 0 VALUE={-1*V(f1lowv)}
Xf1high f1highv 0 f1highp3 f1highp4 0 f1highp6 MY_LIB_USBLC6_2SC6_DS
If1high 0 f1highv 0.01
Ef1high f1highabs 0 VALUE={1*V(f1highv)}
Xf3low f3lowp1 0 f3lowv f3lowp4 0 f3lowp6 MY_LIB_USBLC6_2SC6_DS
If3low 0 f3lowv -0.01
Ef3low f3lowabs 0 VALUE={-1*V(f3lowv)}
Xf3high f3highp1 0 f3highv f3highp4 0 f3highp6 MY_LIB_USBLC6_2SC6_DS
If3high 0 f3highv 0.01
Ef3high f3highabs 0 VALUE={1*V(f3highv)}
Xf4low f4lowp1 0 f4lowp3 f4lowv 0 f4lowp6 MY_LIB_USBLC6_2SC6_DS
If4low 0 f4lowv -0.01
Ef4low f4lowabs 0 VALUE={-1*V(f4lowv)}
Xf4high f4highp1 0 f4highp3 f4highv 0 f4highp6 MY_LIB_USBLC6_2SC6_DS
If4high 0 f4highv 0.01
Ef4high f4highabs 0 VALUE={1*V(f4highv)}
Xf6low f6lowp1 0 f6lowp3 f6lowp4 0 f6lowv MY_LIB_USBLC6_2SC6_DS
If6low 0 f6lowv -0.01
Ef6low f6lowabs 0 VALUE={-1*V(f6lowv)}
Xf6high f6highp1 0 f6highp3 f6highp4 0 f6highv MY_LIB_USBLC6_2SC6_DS
If6high 0 f6highv 0.01
Ef6high f6highabs 0 VALUE={1*V(f6highv)}
.TRAN 1n 10n
.PLOT TRAN v(brv)
.PLOT TRAN v(leakcur)
.PLOT TRAN v(f1lowabs)
.PLOT TRAN v(f1highabs)
.PLOT TRAN v(f3lowabs)
.PLOT TRAN v(f3highabs)
.PLOT TRAN v(f4lowabs)
.PLOT TRAN v(f4highabs)
.PLOT TRAN v(f6lowabs)
.PLOT TRAN v(f6highabs)
.END
